name: @wigxel/react-tf-oxc
description: Transform React function components from arrow functions to function declarations

scripts.demo: tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r sample/src "$tmpdir/src" && pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js --force "$tmpdir/src" && echo '--- Output ---' && cat "$tmpdir/src/default-export.tsx" && rm -rf "$tmpdir"
